name: psyche
description: Explore everyday questions with Korean saju and tarot, right in ChatGPT. No separate Psyche signup needed.

interface.longDescription:
Love, work, or a decision on your mind? Explore it with Psyche’s Korean saju and tarot readings, right in ChatGPT.

Get to know yourself with saju
Share your birth date and, if you know it, your birth time. Explore your tendencies and the themes that relate to your question. If you do not know your birth time, Psyche starts with what can be read and explains what remains uncertain.

Find a fresh perspective with tarot
Choose a one-card reading, three cards for your situation, obstacles and advice, or a relationship reading. Explore possible next steps, ask follow-up questions with the same cards, or request a fresh draw.

Not sure where to start?
Just ask for a fortune reading. Psyche considers both saju and tarot, or begins with tarot while checking any missing birth details. You can choose either method on its own.

Try asking:
“What should I focus on today?”
“What does my saju say about my tendencies?”
“Draw three tarot cards for a career change.”

No separate Psyche signup is needed. Tarot does not need your birth details.

Before you begin
Saju currently supports Korean births from 1900 to 2050, with solar and lunar dates, including leap months. Birth time and gender are optional, with a more limited reading when details are missing. Overseas births and two-person saju compatibility are not supported in this release. Chart and card-image display depend on the features available in ChatGPT.

Psyche does not save your birth details, questions, or reading results. Chat history follows ChatGPT’s policies; hosting providers may process connection information.

Readings are for reflection and entertainment. They cannot establish future events or someone else’s thoughts, and do not replace medical, legal, or financial advice.
defaultPrompt: What should I focus on today? Read my fortune with saju and tarot.
What does my saju say about my tendencies? Ask for the birth details you need.
Draw three tarot cards to help me think about a career change.

positive.description: Known-time Korean solar-calendar saju, optional gender omitted
positive.prompt: Fictional test data, not my personal information: born in Korea on January 1, 1990, solar calendar, at 14:20. Gender not provided. Calculate the saju as of October 29, 2026 and briefly explain the pillars and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return year 己巳, month 丙子, day 丙寅, hour 乙未 from the existing engine, identify the reference date, and preserve evidence and missing-gender limitations. Do not request a Psyche login. Draw the manse chart with hour/day/month/year columns and only returned details. Use an actual graphical figure, never a Markdown/HTML table or ASCII. If the host cannot render a figure, disclose the limitation instead of pretending.

positive.description: Unknown birth time is not guessed
positive.prompt: Fictional test data: born in Korea on January 1, 1990, solar calendar. Birth time is unknown and gender not provided. Show what can be calculated for October 29, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a partial reading with stable year/month pillars only. Do not invent day or hour pillars, day master, or directional luck cycles. Explain missing information. In the manse chart, explicitly leave day/hour and missing details unknown. Use an actual graphical figure, never a Markdown/HTML table or ASCII. If the host cannot render a figure, disclose the limitation instead of pretending.

positive.description: A one-card tarot reading needs no birth details
positive.prompt: For October 29, 2026, draw one tarot card to help me reflect on how to approach a new creative project.
positive.expected_behavior: Draw exactly one card using spread single and explain its actual name, orientation, and returned evidence. Do not ask for birth data or promise a certain future. Retrieve the matching original from the existing Psyche tarot image set using the returned id/imageUrl and display the actual image with card name, position and orientation. Do not substitute URL text or a link list; disclose retrieval/display failure and offer the original link only as a fallback.

positive.description: General fortune uses both perspectives, a manse chart and actual tarot images
positive.prompt: Fictional test data: born in Korea on January 1, 1990, solar calendar, at 14:20. Gender omitted. Please read my general fortune for a new project on October 29, 2026. I have not chosen saju or tarot.
positive.expected_behavior: Call both tools for the same question, work domain and 2026-10-29 reference date. Draw a manse chart from actual saju pillars, retrieve every drawn tarot card’s matching original from Psyche’s existing image set and display the actual images inline, and explain separate saju and tarot perspectives followed by brief practical advice. Do not invent combined scores or certainty. Use an actual graphical figure, never a Markdown/HTML table or ASCII. If the host cannot render a figure, disclose the limitation instead of pretending.

positive.prompt: Draw a relationship spread for a fictional question about communicating with a friend on October 29, 2026. Then explain what the same cards suggest about my next conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Draw three distinct cards using spread relation with me/other/between positions. Reuse that draw for the follow-up and do not claim to know the friend's actual thoughts.

negative.prompt: I was born in Korea on January 1, 1990 at 14:20. Calculate my saju.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask whether the supplied date is solar or lunar before calculation. Do not infer the calendar.

negative.description: Overseas birth is outside this release
negative.prompt: Fictional test data: I was born in New York on January 1, 1990, solar calendar, at 14:20 local time. Calculate my precise saju.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this release supports Korean births only. Do not reinterpret New York local time as Asia/Seoul or return a fabricated calculation.

negative.description: A nonexistent birth date must not be silently corrected
negative.prompt: Fictional test data: born in Korea on February 30, 1990, solar calendar, at 14:20. Calculate my saju.
negative.expected_behavior: Request a valid date or clearly explain the tool's validation error. Do not silently substitute a different date or invent pillars.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, or require a Psyche account.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.5: Rewrote the listing and skill summary in approachable, everyday language with clear question examples. Updated Korean and Japanese listing translations and selected Entertainment. Existing reading workflows, MCP endpoint, logo, privacy practices and supported features are unchanged. Listing translations are included in the package; their display in the directory depends on platform support.

ko-KR.subtitle: 사주와 타로로 풀어보는 오늘의 고민
ko-KR.description:
연애가 어렵게 느껴질 때, 일이 막힐 때, 새로운 선택이 고민될 때. 프시케와 사주·타로로 지금의 질문을 풀어보세요. ChatGPT에서 바로 시작할 수 있습니다.

사주로 나를 조금 더 이해해 보세요
생년월일과 아는 범위의 출생시각을 알려주세요. 사주에서 보는 나의 성향과 흐름을 지금의 고민에 연결해 이야기합니다. 태어난 시각을 몰라도 확인할 수 있는 내용부터 안내합니다.

타로로 다른 시선을 만나보세요
오늘의 한 장, 상황·걸림돌·조언을 살펴보는 세 장, 나·상대·관계를 돌아보는 관계 타로 중에서 골라보세요. 같은 카드로 질문을 이어가거나, 원할 때 새로 뽑을 수 있습니다.

무엇부터 물어볼지 모르겠다면
“오늘 운세 봐줘”라고 말해보세요. 사주와 타로의 두 시선으로 살펴봅니다. 출생정보가 없으면 타로부터 시작하며, 사주에 필요한 내용만 차근차근 확인합니다. 사주만 또는 타로만 이용할 수도 있습니다.

이렇게 시작해 보세요
“오늘 내가 신경 쓰면 좋을 일은?”
“내 사주로 보는 성향이 궁금해.”
“이직 고민을 타로 세 장으로 봐줘.”

프시케 회원가입 없이 이용할 수 있습니다. 타로는 출생정보도 필요 없습니다.

이용 전에 알아두세요
사주는 1900~2050년 한국 출생자를 대상으로 양력·음력과 윤달을 지원합니다. 출생시각과 성별은 선택이며, 정보가 부족하면 해석 범위가 제한됩니다. 해외 출생과 두 사람의 사주 궁합은 아직 지원하지 않습니다. 차트와 카드 이미지 표시는 ChatGPT에서 제공하는 기능에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.

프시케는 출생정보·질문·결과를 저장하지 않습니다. 대화 기록은 ChatGPT 정책을 따르며, 서버 운영사는 접속 정보를 처리할 수 있습니다.

운세는 나를 돌아보고 즐기기 위한 참고입니다. 미래의 사건이나 상대의 생각을 확정하지 않으며, 의료·법률·금융 판단을 대신하지 않습니다.

ja-JP.subtitle: 四柱推命とタロットで今日のヒント
ja-JP.description:
恋愛や仕事、新しい選択に迷うとき。Psycheの四柱推命とタロットで、今の悩みを別の角度から見つめてみませんか。ChatGPTですぐに始められます。

四柱推命で自分を知る
生年月日と、分かる範囲で出生時刻を教えてください。四柱推命から見た傾向や流れを、今の問いにつなげて読み解きます。出生時刻が分からなくても、確認できる内容からご案内します。

タロットで新しい視点を
今日の1枚、状況・障害・助言を考える3枚、自分・相手・関係を見つめる関係のリーディングから選べます。同じカードで質問を続けたり、新しく引き直したりできます。

何から聞けばよいか迷ったら
「今日の運勢を見て」と話しかけてください。四柱推命とタロットの2つの視点で考えます。出生情報がない場合はタロットから始め、四柱推命に必要な情報だけ確認します。どちらか一方だけでも利用できます。

たとえば、こんな質問から
「今日、意識するとよいことは？」
「四柱推命で私の傾向を知りたい」
「転職の悩みをタロット3枚で見て」

Psyche専用アカウントの登録は不要です。タロットには出生情報も必要ありません。

ご利用の前に
四柱推命は1900〜2050年に韓国で生まれた方を対象に、陽暦・陰暦と閏月に対応します。出生時刻と性別は任意ですが、情報が不足すると読み取れる範囲が限られます。韓国外での出生や2人の四柱推命による相性診断には、まだ対応していません。チャートやカード画像の表示は、ChatGPTで利用できる機能により異なります。

Psycheは出生情報・質問・結果を保存しません。会話履歴はChatGPTの方針に従い、ホスティング提供者は接続情報を処理する場合があります。

自己理解と娯楽のための参考情報です。未来の出来事や相手の考えを断定せず、医療・法律・金融の判断を代替しません。
